description: This file defines the ConsistentRingQueueBalancer class, which implements a queue balancing strategy based on consistent hashing within the Orleans streaming framework. It manages queue assignments and responds to ring range changes.

classes.name: ConsistentRingQueueBalancer
classes.description: Implements a queue balancer that uses consistent hashing to assign queues within the Orleans streaming infrastructure. It listens for ring range changes and manages queue mappings accordingly.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of ConsistentRingQueueBalancer using dependency injection.

methods.name: ConsistentRingQueueBalancer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the queue balancer with the ring provider, logger, and services, and subscribes to ring range change events.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the queue balancer with a queue mapper, ensuring it implements the required interface.

methods.name: GetMyQueues
methods.description: Returns the list of queues assigned to this node based on the current ring range.

methods.name: OnClusterMembershipChange
methods.description: Handles changes in cluster membership; currently empty.

methods.name: RangeChangeNotification
methods.description: Updates the ring range upon notification and triggers listener updates.
